Summary
Build AI native, HANA optimized SAP applications and extensions by combining deep ABAP on HANA engineering with agentic AI patterns (LLMs + tools + retrieval + evaluation). The role focuses on delivering high performance, cloud ready, production-grade solutions using HANA pushdown principles, modern ABAP, and governed AI capabilities that can reason, retrieve context, and assist or act within enterprise SAP workflowswithout training foundation models from scratch.

Core Responsibilities
1) ABAP on HANA Engineering (Performance First)
Design and develop ABAP solutions optimized for SAP HANA using pushdown principles (minimize data movement, maximize in database processing).
Build efficient data models and access patterns using CDS views, associations, annotations, and authorization concepts.
Implement performance critical logic using AMDP / SQLScript where appropriate, with careful governance and testing.
2) Modern ABAP Development Clean Design
Develop modular, testable, and maintainable ABAP code aligned to clean architecture practices and enterprise SDLC.
Build services and APIs using modern paradigms (OData/service exposure patterns), ensuring stability, versioning, and contract-first behavior.
Apply secure coding standards and authorization checks consistently across data and service layers.
3) Data Modeling, Reporting Semantic Enablement
Model enterprise business entities using CDS semantics to support both transactional and analytical consumption.
Design reusable data artifacts that support downstream consumers (UI, integrations, analytics, and AI retrieval layers).
Ensure lineage-friendly structures and consistent business definitions to reduce ambiguity across systems.
4) AI Native SAP Capabilities (Agentic + Grounded)
Build AI enabled SAP experiences that integrate ABAP services with LLM capabilities, including:
oTool calling orchestration (LLM triggers approved SAP actions via controlled APIs)
oRetrieval grounded outputs (RAG style grounding) over governed SAP data and documentation
oDeterministic fallbacks when grounding is weak or confidence is low
Implement prompts/templates, tool schemas, and context assembly strategies that reduce hallucinations and enforce enterprise safety boundaries.
5) Quality Engineering Evaluation Loops (AI + ABAP)
Build automated tests (unit/integration/contract) for ABAP services and data artifacts enforce regression coverage for performance and correctness.
Establish evaluation harnesses for AI behaviors:offline golden datasets, scenario-based tests, and online monitoring to detect drift/regressions.
Introduce guardrails for AI outputs:authorization-aware context filtering, redaction rules, action confirmations, and audit logs.
6) Observability, Reliability Operations
Instrument services and critical logic with logs/metrics/traces suitable for production support and root-cause analysis.
Design robust error handling for enterprise flows:retries, idempotency, correlation IDs, and safe failure modes.
Support incident response with runbooks and structured diagnostics continuously harden solutions based on observed failure patterns.
7) Integration End to End Delivery
Integrate ABAP on HANA services with SAP and non SAP ecosystems (event-driven patterns, API gateways, enterprise integration layers).
Collaborate with UX, integration, data, and platform teams to ensure end to end solution correctness and performance.
Prototype rapidly, demonstrate frequently, and evolve prototypes into scalable production systems with security and compliance baked in.

Primary Skills (AI Native Must Have)
Strong hands on expertise in ABAP Development on HANA (performance tuning, pushdown, efficient SQL access patterns).
Proficiency with CDS views and modern data modeling practices (associations, annotations, authorization concepts).
Experience with AMDP / SQLScript for performance critical scenarios and controlled code pushdown.
Solid software engineering discipline:clean design, testing mindset, CI/CD orientation, and production readiness.
AI native build capability:LLM integration, retrieval grounding, tool orchestration, evaluation loops, and safety boundaries.

Secondary / Strongly Beneficial Skills
OData/service design patterns, API lifecycle management, and contract-first development.
Experience integrating SAP backends with cloud runtimes and enterprise integration platforms.
Familiarity with performance benchmarking, load testing, and query-plan driven tuning practices.
Knowledge of SAP security/authorizations and compliance requirements for sensitive enterprise data.

What This Role Does Not Center On
Training or fine tuning foundation models from scratch.
AI assisted only development this role builds and owns AI behaviors (grounding, evaluation, guardrails, observability) as part of SAP solution delivery.

Value Delivered
High performance SAP solutions through HANA optimized ABAP engineering and disciplined pushdown design.
Faster delivery of intelligent SAP workflows via agentic AI patterns that are grounded, governed, and measurable.
Reduced operational risk through automated testing, observability, and robust safety boundaries for AI-enabled actions.

Educational Qualification :15 years full time education

Summary
You will design, configure, and enhance SAP Production Planning (PP) processes for discrete manufacturing environments while using AI assisted development tools and copilots to accelerate requirement analysis, configuration, testing, documentation, and issue resolution. The role focuses on delivering efficient production planning, shop floor execution, and material staging processes while integrating pre built AI services where beneficial. No deep AI model engineering, vector DB work, RAG, or agentic system development is required.


Key Responsibilities
Functional Technical Delivery
Configure and support SAP PP processes including:
oMaterial Requirement Planning (MRP)
oProduction Orders Execution
oRoutings, Work Centers BOM Management
oCapacity Planning Scheduling
oBackflushing Costing Integration
oGoods Movements Shop floor Reporting
Use AI copilots to accelerate:
oFunctional specification creation
oRouting/BOM validation
oTest case generation for MRP, order creation, confirmations
oDocumentation automation (FS/TS/SOPs)
Support full lifecycle delivery:requirements, design, configuration, SIT/UAT, deployment, hypercare support.
Integrate PP with MM, QM, SD, FI/CO, and shop floor systems (MES), leveraging standard APIs and middleware.
AI Assisted Productivity
Use AI copilots for:
oAutomated summarization of requirements and change impacts
oAnalysis of MRP exceptions and planning alerts
oValidation of order execution and production variances
oFaster defect isolation in BOM/routing/work center configurations
Integrate pre built AI services into production workflows, such as:
oPredictive insights (e.g., potential material shortages or order delays)
oIntelligent classification of production issues
oAutomated summarization of production batch deviations
oSmart suggestions based on historical production performance
Use LLM assisted troubleshooting to reduce time spent analyzing MRP exception messages, order failures, and material shortages.
Governance, Quality Collaboration
Ensure compliance with production governance, change controls, data accuracy standards, and audit policies.
Participate in workshops, solution reviews, and process optimization discussions enhanced by AI generated insights.
Collaborate with production, quality, warehouse, procurement, cost controlling, and integration teams to deliver end to end planning excellence.
Create reusable templates, checklists, test packs, and AI enabled best practices for SAP PP delivery.

Required Skills Experience
SAP PP Expertise
Strong understanding of discrete manufacturing processes including BOM/routing management, production order cycles, capacity planning, scheduling, and MRP.
Experience with integration across MM (material availability), QM (inspection lots), SD (demand), and FI/CO (costing).
Familiarity with order confirmations, settlements, and shop floor data capture processes.
AI Ready Skills
Ability to use AI copilots, automated documentation tools, and AI assisted test accelerators.
Comfortable embedding pre built AI capabilities into production planning or execution (not custom model building).
Awareness of responsible AI usage and limitations in manufacturing and planning environments.
General Professional Skills
Strong analytical and problem solving skills related to production variability, MRP outcomes, and resource planning.
Ability to translate manufacturing requirements into scalable SAP PP configurations.
Strong communication and collaboration skills across technical and operational teams.
Continuous learning mindset with comfort adopting AI assisted workflows.

Good to Have
SAP PP Certification (S/4HANA Manufacturing).
Experience with MES systems, shop floor integrations, or IoT enabled production data.
Exposure to EWM/WM, PM, or APO/IBP environments.
Familiarity with automated testing tools (Tricentis, CBTA).

Outcome Expectations
Deliver faster, more reliable SAP PP solutions using AI enabled productivity tools.
Improve planning accuracy, resource utilization, and production stability.
Act as a bridge between manufacturing teams, SAP engineering teams, and AI native experts when deeper AI capabilities are required.


Additional Information
A 15 years full time education is required.
Qualification15 years full time education

AI Native SAP Application Build
Design and build ABAP Cloud applications that embed LLM driven intelligence into SAP business processes.
Implement AI enabled SAP extensions using RESTful ABAP Programming Model (RAP), event driven patterns, and cloud native architectures.

Agentic LLM Integration
Implement agentic workflows:tools, planners, memory, orchestration, and evaluation loops integrated with SAP processes.

Design prompt templates, grounding strategies, fallback logic, and safety boundaries suitable for enterprise SAP use cases.
Data, Retrieval Context
Build and integrate retrieval pipelines using SAP and non SAP data sources (business objects, CDS views, documents, events).
Implement chunking, indexing, embeddings, and context assembly to support production grade RAG scenarios.
Ensure factuality, traceability, and explainability in AI driven SAP workflows.
Quality, Safety Reliability
Implement evaluation frameworks (offline and online) for AI behaviors integrated with SAP processes.
Design guardrails for authorization, data privacy, action boundaries, and error handling.
Build observability into AI enabled SAP applications (telemetry, logging, failure analysis).
Rapid Experimentation Scale Out
Prototype quickly, demo frequently, and iterate based on business feedback.
Move AI prototypes into enterprise grade SAP production systems with performance, security, and compliance in mind.
Continuously refine AI behavior, prompts, and orchestration strategies.

Primary Skills (AI Native Must Have)
SAP ABAP Cloud (RAP, CDS, OData, clean core principles).
Hands on experience integrating LLMs and AI services into applications.
Experience building RAG pipelines, embeddings, and contextual retrieval.
Strong software engineering fundamentals (design, testing, CI/CD).
Ability to translate business problems into AI enabled SAP solutions.

Secondary / Strongly Beneficial Skills
Experience with SAP BTP, eventing, APIs, and cloud services.
Familiarity with agent frameworks or custom orchestration logic.
Exposure to vector databases, search, or semantic indexing (SAP native or external).

oValidation of order execution and production variances

oPredictive insights (e.g., potential material shortages or order delays)

oSmart suggestions based on historical production performance

Participate in workshops, solution reviews, and process optimization discussions enhanced by AI generated insights.

SAP PP Expertise

Familiarity with order confirmations, settlements, and shop floor data capture processes.

Comfortable embedding pre built AI capabilities into production planning or execution (not custom model building).
Awareness of responsible AI usage and limitations in manufacturing and planning environments.

Strong analytical and problem solving skills related to production variability, MRP outcomes, and resource planning.
Ability to translate manufacturing requirements into scalable SAP PP configurations.
Strong communication and collaboration skills across technical and operational teams.
Continuous learning mindset with comfort adopting AI assisted workflows.

Exposure to EWM/WM, PM, or APO/IBP environments.

jobDescription:
About The Role

Project Role :Custom Software Engineer


Project Role Description :Design, build and configure applications to meet business process and application requirements.
Must have skills :SAP ABAP Cloud

Good to have skills :NA
Minimum

5 year(s) of experience is required

Educational Qualification :15 years full time education

Summary
Build AI native, cloud ready SAP solutions on ABAP Cloud by combining deep ABAP and SAP platform expertise with agentic AI architectures, LLM tooling, and rapid experimentation. The role focuses on designing, implementing, and scaling intelligent SAP applications that integrate ABAP Cloud with LLMs, retrieval pipelines, APIs, and enterprise systemsmoving from automation to autonomy.
This role actively builds AI systems, not just consumes AI tools.

Core Responsibilities
AI Native SAP Application Build
Design and build ABAP Cloud applications that embed LLM driven intelligence into SAP business processes.
Implement AI enabled SAP extensions using RESTful ABAP Programming Model (RAP), event driven patterns, and cloud native architectures.
Develop clean, testable ABAP code that integrates seamlessly with AI services and enterprise APIs.
Agentic LLM Integration
Implement agentic workflows:tools, planners, memory, orchestration, and evaluation loops integrated with SAP processes.
Integrate LLMs, embeddings, and retrieval pipelines (RAG) with ABAP Cloud services for contextual, grounded responses.
Design prompt templates, grounding strategies, fallback logic, and safety boundaries suitable for enterprise SAP use cases.
Data, Retrieval Context
Build and integrate retrieval pipelines using SAP and non SAP data sources (business objects, CDS views, documents, events).
Implement chunking, indexing, embeddings, and context assembly to support production grade RAG scenarios.
Ensure factuality, traceability, and explainability in AI driven SAP workflows.
Quality, Safety Reliability
Implement evaluation frameworks (offline and online) for AI behaviors integrated with SAP processes.
Design guardrails for authorization, data privacy, action boundaries, and error handling.
Build observability into AI enabled SAP applications (telemetry, logging, failure analysis).
Rapid Experimentation Scale Out
Prototype quickly, demo frequently, and iterate based on business feedback.
Move AI prototypes into enterprise grade SAP production systems with performance, security, and compliance in mind.
Continuously refine AI behavior, prompts, and orchestration strategies.

Primary Skills (AI Native Must Have)
SAP ABAP Cloud (RAP, CDS, OData, clean core principles).
Hands on experience integrating LLMs and AI services into applications.
Experience building RAG pipelines, embeddings, and contextual retrieval.
Strong software engineering fundamentals (design, testing, CI/CD).
Ability to translate business problems into AI enabled SAP solutions.

Secondary / Strongly Beneficial Skills
Experience with SAP BTP, eventing, APIs, and cloud services.
Familiarity with agent frameworks or custom orchestration logic.
Exposure to vector databases, search, or semantic indexing (SAP native or external).
Knowledge of enterprise security, authorization, and compliance patterns.


Value Delivered
Intelligent SAP applications that reason, retrieve, and act, not just automate.
Faster innovation cycles by embedding AI directly into SAP business logic.
Scalable, secure AI powered SAP extensions aligned with clean core principles.
Foundation for autonomous, AI driven enterprise workflows.


Additional Information
A 15 years full time education is required.
Qualification15 years full time education

  • Fix artifacts, handle color grading, and ensure temporal stability (no "flickering").
  • 3D & Gaming Integration: Work with Unreal Engine 5 or Blender to create realistic environments and integrate digital avatars if required.
  • Character Consistency: Train or fine-tune models (LoRAs/ControlNet) to ensure characters look exactly the same across different shots and angles.

  • The "Real" Tech Stack (Non-Negotiable): VFX/Editing: Mastery of Adobe After Effects (Compositing, Roto), Premiere Pro, and DaVinci Resolve (Color Grading).

  • The AI Stack (Deep Knowledge Required): Video Gen: Runway Gen-3 Alpha, Kling AI, Luma Dream Machine, or Haiper.
  • Image Gen: Midjourney v6 (Advanced Parameters), Stable Diffusion (ComfyUI workflows are a huge plus).
  • Lip-Sync & Voice: ElevenLabs, HeyGen, or LivePortrait.
  • Optimization: Topaz Video AI (Upscaling) and interpolation tools.
  • Soft Skills: "Director's Eye": You understand cinematographyfocal lengths, shutter angles, lighting setups (Rim light, Key light), and composition.
  • Problem Solving: AI makes mistakes.
  • You must know how to fix "weird hands" or "glitchy eyes" manually in post-production.

Nice-to-Have (Bonus Points)

  • Experience in the Gaming Industry (Level Design, Cinematics, or Character Rigging).
  • Knowledge of ComfyUI Node systems for complex Stable Diffusion workflows.
  • Experience with Python scripting for automating media workflows.
  • Background in traditional art or photography.
  • Who You Are You don't just type "Make a cool video" into ChatGPT.
  • You write detailed prompts like "Cinematic wide shot, 35mm lens, volumetric lighting, cyberpunk street, unreal engine 5 render style --ar 16:9".
  • You are frustrated when AI video looks "wobbly" and you know exactly how to stabilize it.
  • You have an open mindset: You are willing to relearn your workflow every month as technology changes.

oValidation of order execution and production variances

Continuous learning mindset with comfort adopting AI assisted workflows.

About SC - Global Network (GN) :- Accenture GNs Data AI (AI Hub India) practice help our clients grow their business in entirely new ways. Analytics enables our clients to achieve high performance through insights from data - insights that inform better decisions and strengthen customer relationships. From strategy to execution, Accenture works with organizations to develop analytic capabilities - from accessing and reporting on data to predictive modelling to outperform the competition.

WHATS IN IT FOR YOU

As part of our Analytics practice, you will join a worldwide network of over 20k+ smart and driven colleagues experienced in leading AI/ML/Statistical tools/Agentic AI systems, methods and applications. From data to analytics and insights to actions, our forward-thinking consultants provide analytically-informed, issue-based insights at scale to help our clients improve outcomes and achieve high performance.

What you would do in this role

A Consultant/Manager/Analyst for Customer Data Platforms serves as the day-to-day marketing technology point of contact and helps our clients get value out of their investment into a Customer Data Platform (CDP) by developing a strategic roadmap focused on personalized activation. You will be working with a multidisciplinary team of Solution Architects, Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and Digital Marketers.

As part of that, we are seeking a highly skilled Consultant/Manager/Analyst to architect, build, and operationalize custom Customer Data Platforms (CDPs), Agentic AI systems and marketing data solutions on the Google Cloud Platform (GCP). You will be at the intersection of data engineering, MLOps, and marketing technology, building the foundational infrastructure that enables our clients to understand their customers, predict their needs, and deliver personalized experiences at scale.



Key Duties and Responsibilities:(GCP CDP)
  • Architect Design: Lead the technical design and architecture of enterprise-grade, custom CDPs and marketing data warehouses on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Build Production-Grade Data Pipelines: Engineer robust, scalable, and automated data pipelines for both streaming and batch ingestion using services like Cloud Dataflow, Pub/Sub, and Cloud Functions. Containerize processing jobs with Docker for portability and scalability.
  • Model for Insight Activation: Design and implement data models in BigQuery optimized for customer identity resolution, 360-degree profile creation, segmentation, and analytics.
  • Champion DevOps MLOps: Champion and implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform. Build CI/CD pipelines using Cloud Build to automate testing and deployment, manage container images in Artifact Registry, and secure credentials using Google Secret Manager.
  • Deploy Serve: Develop and deploy containerized, serverless APIs (using Docker and Cloud Run) for real-time data ingestion and activation, feeding customer segments and triggers into marketing platforms.
  • Operationalize Machine Learning: Collaborate with data scientists to productionize ML models (e.g., propensity, LTV, segmentation) using the Vertex AI platform. Build automated training pipelines, and deploy models for real-time inference.

jobDescription:
As Business Resilience Manager within Ecolabs Global Business Solutions+ (GBS+) Enterprise AI organization, you will lead the execution of a critical capabilityensuring the continuity and resilience of essential global services. GBS+ is a multifunctional shared services platform supporting Finance, Supply Chain, Marketing, Legal, HR, Real Estate, and Automation across five global locations. In this role, you will own the development, testing, and continuous improvement of business continuity and resilience plans, enabling both GBS+ and AI operations to withstand and recover from disruptions. You will provide strategic oversight, expert guidance, and handson support to proactively manage risk, strengthen preparedness, and drive effective incident response. Reporting to the Sr. Director of Strategy Governance, you will partner closely with functional leaders to embed resilience into business planning, elevate organizational readiness, and ensure alignment with enterprise standards.

  • The ability to make an impact and shape your career with a company that is passionate about growth
  • The support of an organization that believes it is vital to include and engage diverse people, perspectives, and ideas to achieve our best
  • Be part of an outstanding team with relentless focus on improvement through digital enhancements, process automation and AI opportunities

What You Will Do:

  • Partner with functional and site stakeholders to conduct risk assessments and business impact assessments, evaluating the impact of potential disruptions across GBS+ processes and global locations

  • Establish and govern a structured cadence for BCP testing, review, and updates to ensure plans remain current with organizational changes and site operations
  • Maintain an inventory of AI-supported services and process dependencies; tier criticality and document potential failure modes

  • Design, document, and test fallback procedures when AI is unavailable, including manual workarounds, human review queues, and nonAI alternatives (rules-based logic, templates, and standard operating procedures)

  • Support GBS+ leadership during real disruption events, coordinating response activities and ensuring effective execution of continuity plans
  • Collaborate with digital, technology, and operations teams to strengthen the resilience of critical systems and services, including resilience plans for AI-supported services

title: Senior Agentic AI Engineer
tagsAndSkills: cloud,RAG,LLM,agentic AI,Python,Langchain,Langgraph,Senior
jobDescription:
Job title: Senior Agentic AI Engineer
Experience : 6+ Years
Location : Pune/Banglore
Work Mode : Remote
Notice Period: Immediate

The Opportunity
This is a role in a new AI engineering squad. You'll work across the full agentic stack from designing agent architectures and RAG pipelines to shipping autonomous agents that replace manual processes in production. Hands-on, delivery-focused, and consequential from day one.

What You'll Do
Agents
• Design and build multi-agent systems for autonomous reasoning, planning, and task execution
• Architect orchestration patterns; tool use, memory, reflection loops, human-in-the-loop handoffs
• Deliver across use cases: developer productivity agents, knowledge retrieval agents, and process
automation
• Favour GCP-native and enterprise-grade managed services before writing custom infrastructure, we're
not in the business of rebuilding what a major cloud vendor will productise in six months
RAG, Knowledge & Graph
• Design and implement end-to-end RAG architectures ingestion, chunking, embedding, retrieval,
reranking
• Select and manage vector databases appropriate to the use case
• Build knowledge pipelines that turn unstructured client data into queryable intelligence
• Apply knowledge graph structures (e.g. Neo4j) where relational or semantic reasoning adds value
beyond flat vector retrieval
Evaluation & Observability
• Design and own eval frameworks; automated evals, LLM-as-a-Judge, task-completion harnesses
• Define what 'working correctly' looks like for each agent and measure it continuously in production
• Instrument agents for cost, latency, and quality
Platform & Collaboration
• Contribute to platform standards how agents are built, deployed, monitored, and governed
• Ensure agents are production-grade: observable, cost-aware, GDPR and EU AI Act compliant
• Work with engineering, business stakeholders, and the Director of Platform, Engineering & AI to
translate process problems into agentic solutions
What We're Looking For
Must-Have
• Production experience building and deploying agentic AI systems not just prototypes
• Strong Python engineering: clean, tested, maintainable code
• Hands-on RAG pipeline design chunking strategies, embedding models, retrieval, evaluation
• Production experience with at least one vector database
• LLM evaluation experience automated evals, LLM-as-a-Judge, or equivalent agent accuracy
measurement
• Familiarity with agent frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or similar) and the
judgement to know when not to use them
• Solid LLM fundamentals: prompting, tool calling, structured outputs, context management
• Cloud infrastructure comfort GCP preferred; strong AWS/Azure considered
Nice-to-Have
• Google Agent Development Kit (ADK) or Vertex AI Agent Builder
• MCP (Model Context Protocol) and agent-to-agent communication patterns
• Knowledge graphs or graph databases (Neo4j, JanusGraph) in retrieval or reasoning contexts
• LLMOps / observability tooling LangSmith, Langfuse, or equivalent
• Experience building agents in regulated or enterprise environments
• Background in BPO, AP automation, or document processing workflows
What Good Looks Like
• Shipped agents, not demos production deployment matters more than framework familiarity
• Engineering mindset you care about reliability, cost, testability, and observability
• Built evals, not vibes you measure whether agents work and instrument from day one
• Build-vs-buy judgment you reach for GCP-native and enterprise tooling before writing custom
infrastructure you've seen bespoke orchestration layers made redundant by a platform release, and
you build accordingly
• Comfortable with ambiguity you help define the patterns rather than follow them
• Business curious you want to understand the process you're automating, not just the stack
A Note on This Role
Agentic AI engineering is genuinely new. We don't expect 10 years of experience in a discipline that's 2 years
old. What we do expect is evidence of building real things, strong software engineering foundations, and the
intellectual curiosity to stay ahead of a fast-moving field. If you've been doing this seriously for 18 months and
have production systems to show for it, we want to hear from you.

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Generative AI Developer to join our AI/ML team. They will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to design, implement, and optimize AI-driven solutions, with exposure to cloud-native AI platforms like Amazon Bedrock and Microsoft Azure OpenAI considered a plus.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and deploy GenAI-based applications to solve complex business problems.

    • Prompt Engineering creating specific prompts to guide LLM outputs
    • Fine Tuning and Few-Shot learning Adapting LLMs for domain-specific tasks.
    • Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) Combining LLMs with external data retrieval systems

  • Expertise in designing and implementing chunking strategies for diverse datasets.

  • Solid programming skills in Python, with experience in AI/ML libraries such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Hugging Face Transformers.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms and services for AI/ML workloads (AWS or Azure).

Desirable Skills:

  • Exposure to different chunking strategies, including overlap and semantic segmentation.
  • Understanding of DevOps practices for deploying and managing AI models in production.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills with a focus on delivering value-driven solutions.

Years of Experience:

jobDescription:
This Position reports to:
RD Leader(Industrial Software)-AUEN BL

What we believe in
ABBs Process Automation business area enables customers to operate some of the worlds largest and most complex industrial infrastructures, helping them outrun leaner and cleaner.
We offer a broad range of automation, electrification and digital solutions for process, hybrid and maritime industries, including industry-specific integrated control and software as well as measurement and analytics solutions and services.


Your role and responsibilities
In this role, we are looking for a highly experienced and hands-on AI Lead Autonomous to join our Industrial Automation Digital Organization. The role will be responsible for driving the Autonomous Framework as a program and translating prioritized AI use cases into delivered, validated outcomes. The candidate will directly contribute to AI solution design, prototyping and delivery while providing technical leadership across Generative AI, Agentic AI and Classical Machine Learning for industrial applications.
This is a hands-on technical leadership role, requiring strong execution discipline, stakeholder management and the ability to drive outcomes across product, platform, architecture, technology partners and pilot customers. The role will also contribute to AI-led margin acceleration initiatives and provide delivery and feasibility inputs into AI use-case prioritization. As the organization scales, the role will have an opportunity to build and lead a team of AI engineers.
The work model for the role is: Hybrid


You will be mainly accountable for
  • Drive AI-led margin acceleration and hands-on AI delivery by identifying high-impact AI opportunities and directly contributing to solution design, prototyping, development and implementation using Generative AI, Agentic AI and Classical Machine Learning for industrial applications.
  • Lead Autonomous Framework execution and program visibility by establishing the operating cadence, managing milestones, dependencies and releases, maintaining execution visibility, and providing concise, decision-ready updates on progress, risks, blockers and required actions.
  • Drive execution discipline, technical feasibility and stakeholder coordination by defining clear objectives, scope, success criteria and decision gates for AI initiatives, managing cross-functional dependencies, addressing risks and blockers, and providing input into prioritization and build-vs-buy decisions.
  • Build technical capability and partner alignment by acting as a senior AI SME, collaborating with architects, product teams, platform teams and partners such as Microsoft and Cognite, and progressively building and leading a small team of AI engineers as the function scales.


Qualifications for the role:
  • 15+ years of experience in software engineering, data science or analytics, including 7+ years of hands-on experience in Generative AI, Agentic AI and/or Classical Machine Learning.
  • Strong hands-on expertise in LLMs, RAG, MCP, agentic orchestration, agentic harnesses and agentic architecture, with proven experience delivering AI solutions in industrial domains.
  • Proven experience developing Classical ML and Neural Network models, with strong knowledge of MLOps and cloud/edge deployment.
  • Demonstrated experience in driving execution across multiple teams and technology partners, influencing outcomes without direct authority and managing complex dependencies, risks and delivery milestones.
  • Strong understanding of AI solution architecture, experimentation, prototyping and production deployment, with the ability to translate business priorities into technically feasible and executable AI workstreams.
  • Strong communication, stakeholder-management and leadership skills, with the ability to simplify complex technical concepts for senior leadership and bring structure to ambiguous and rapidly evolving initiatives.
  • BE/BTech/ME/MTech in Engineering, Computer Science or a related field; advanced degree preferred. Experience in industrial software, process automation, energy, autonomous operations, asset performance, manufacturing execution or energy management, along with exposure to Microsoft/Cognite ecosystems and scaled Agile/program execution, is an added advantage.


More about us
ABB is a leading global technology company that energizes the transformation of society and industry to achieve a more productive, sustainable future. The Process Automation (PA) business area (>$6B revenue in 2021, 22,000 employees), automates, electrifies and digitalizes some of the most complex industrial infrastructures on this planet. Through its five divisions, it serves customers in the energy, process and hybrid industries from hydrocarbons, chemicals, water, mining, minerals, pulp paper to marine and ports, and many more. PA stands at the heart of some of the most important shifts in society, helping the energy-intense industries to safer, smarter and more sustainable operations to enable a prosperous, low-carbon society.

AIVAR INNOVATIONS
Senior Voice AI Engineer - Convogent Delivery

About Aivar Innovations
Aivar Innovations is an AI-native services and software company and an AWS Preferred Partner, backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and Sorin Investments. We ship production-grade AI into enterprise environments across fintech, healthcare, and technology. Our work is anchored by four accelerator platforms: Convogent (voice and agent AI automation), Velogent (governed agentic process automation for regulated industries), Kubogent (Kubernetes-native AIOps), and Datagent (data and analytics). We measure ourselves by what runs in production, not by slideware.
Role Overview
We are hiring a Senior Voice AI Engineer for Aivars Delivery organization to take voice AI use cases from discovery through live production for our enterprise customers. You will build and customize voice agents on top of Convogent - Aivars voice AI accelerator - working directly within customer engagements, delivery timelines, and SOW commitments. This is a hands-on engineering role embedded in customer-facing delivery pods, partnering closely with Delivery Managers, Solution Architects, and customer technical stakeholders to ship measurable outcomes on live calls.
What Youll Do
  • Own customer delivery outcomes. Take voice AI use cases from discovery through production go-live within committed timelines, working inside Rocketlane-tracked delivery plans alongside your Delivery Manager.
  • Customize and configure Convogent. Adapt Aivars voice AI accelerator (built on Pipecat, LiveKit) to each customers telephony stack (Twilio, Exotel, Cisco, Vonage, etc.), API/MCP integrations with customer CRM tools, knowledge base (KB) integrations, compliance constraints, and use-case requirements.
  • Engineer real-time audio pipelines for production. Optimize STT and TTS flows for the latency, concurrency, and call quality bar each customer engagement demands.
  • Troubleshoot customer production systems. When a live call does not sound right, quickly narrow down where in the pipeline it broke - capture, STT, orchestration, or TTS - by asking the right questions, reading the right signals, and driving the fix through to resolution.
  • Build and adapt the orchestration layer. Connect STT, TTS, and LLM agents into resilient, observable workflows with guardrails suited to the customers risk and compliance profile.
  • Translate customer requirements into deployable solutions. Work directly with customer technical stakeholders alongside Aivars SA and DM to scope, size, and iterate use cases against measurable outcomes - success rate, latency, adoption.
  • Report and govern delivery. Contribute to sprint tracking, status reporting, and stakeholder governance for the use cases you own.
What Youll Bring
  • Hands-on experience building and deploying voice agents with Pipecat, LiveKit, or similar frameworks - ideally across multiple distinct production deployments, not a single system.
  • Deep expertise in STT (Deepgram, Whisper, AssemblyAI, Google STT, Sarvam) and TTS (ElevenLabs, Cartesia, Amazon Polly).
  • Working knowledge of Speech-to-Speech (S2S) services, including Amazon Nova Sonic, and how they change pipeline and orchestration design compared to cascaded STT/LLM/TTS.
  • Experience with multi-speaker diarization and conversation segmentation.
  • Production fluency in Python plus at least one of Node.js, TypeScript, or Go.
  • Practical use of AI/ML libraries (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn) and conversational AI design - prompt engineering and integration with LLMs (GPT-4o, Claude, Bedrock models).
  • Cloud deployment experience on AWS (Lambda, EC2, S3, EKS, Polly, Transcribe, Bedrock) with Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD.
  • Demonstrated ability to work under SOW/contract constraints - scoping, prioritizing, and shipping within a defined timeline and budget across live customer engagements.
  • Comfort working across multiple concurrent customer engagements with differing requirements, tech stacks, and stakeholders.
Preferred Experience

jobDescription:
Copilot Studio Senior Developer

location: Pan India

Role Summary

We are looking for a Copilot Studio Senior Developer to build and ship custom AI agents (copilots) that plug into our clients' Microsoft 365 and Power Platform estates. This is a hands-on role. You will design conversation flows, wire agents to enterprise data and actions, and take them through to production with the right grounding, testing, and guardrails. You should be comfortable owning an agent end to end and mentoring less experienced developers on the team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and build custom agents in Copilot Studio, including topics, trigger phrases, conversation flows, and generative answers grounded on enterprise knowledge sources.
  • Configure knowledge sources (SharePoint, Dataverse, public and internal websites, files) and tune grounding so agents give accurate, in-scope responses.
  • Build actions that let agents do real work by connecting to Power Automate flows, connectors, Microsoft Graph, and custom or REST APIs.
  • Implement authentication and secure data access for agents, using Entra ID and appropriate permission scopes.
  • Handle agent lifecycle: environment strategy, solution packaging, testing, and publishing across channels such as Teams, M365 Copilot, and websites.
  • Apply prompt design and generative orchestration to balance scripted control with generative flexibility, and test for accuracy, safety, and unwanted behaviour.
  • Support and troubleshoot agents in production, including analytics review, fixing failed actions, and improving grounding based on usage.
  • Mentor developers and contribute reusable patterns, prompts, and components back to the team.

Must-Have Skills

  • Strong hands-on Copilot Studio experience: topics, generative answers, knowledge sources, actions, and publishing.
  • Solid Power Platform grounding, especially Power Automate and connectors, and working knowledge of Dataverse.
  • Experience connecting agents to data and actions via Microsoft Graph, connectors, and REST APIs.
  • Understanding of Entra ID, authentication, and permission/consent models for secure agent access.
  • Practical prompt engineering and an understanding of generative AI behaviour, grounding, and limitations.
  • Ability to test, monitor, and iterate on agents using the built-in analytics.

Good-to-Have Skills

  • Understanding of RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) concepts and how grounding, chunking, and retrieval quality affect answer accuracy.
  • Some scripting ability (Python or PowerShell) for custom connectors and Azure Functions.
  • SPFx or Power Apps development for surfacing or embedding agents in custom experiences.
  • Azure services (Functions, Logic Apps, AI services) for extending agents beyond low-code.
  • Exposure to pro-code agent frameworks (Semantic Kernel, Azure AI Foundry) for hybrid low-code plus pro-code scenarios.

title: Python Architect - AI

jobDescription:
Role summary

As Senior Python Architect, you will own the technical strategy and hands-on design for re-platforming the HIVE backend from PL/SQL to Python. You will reverse-engineer the current codebase, document the embedded business logic and data flows, define a target Python architecture (FastAPI, asynchronous processing, clean data-access patterns), establish a pragmatic and low-risk migration strategy with parity validation, and guide the engineering team through delivery. You will be hands-on producing reference implementations and resolving the hardest technical problems while also setting standards, mentoring engineers, and aligning with SFI's enterprise architecture governance (ARB).

Key responsibilities

Current-state assessment & discovery

  • Review the existing HIVE system end-to-end PL/SQL packages, procedures, functions, triggers, cursors, scheduled jobs, and the React front-end touchpoints.
  • Reverse-engineer and document the embedded business logic, data models, integrations, batch/long-running processes, and dependencies that must be preserved.
  • Identify complexity hotspots, technical debt, performance bottlenecks, and risk areas; quantify the conversion effort and produce a phased, prioritized conversion blueprint.

Target architecture & design

  • Define the target-state Python architecture: service decomposition, FastAPI API design, asynchronous execution model (async/await, ASGI), data-access layer, configuration, and deployment topology.
  • Design patterns for asynchronous and long-running jobs (background workers, task queues, concurrency, idempotency, retries) to replace PL/SQL batch and scheduled processing.
  • Establish coding standards, project structure, reusable frameworks/accelerators, and Definition of Done; author Architecture Decision Records (ADRs).
  • Define non-functional requirements — performance, scalability, security, observability, and maintainability — and design to meet them.

PL/SQL Python conversion strategy

  • Define a low-risk migration approach (e.g., incremental / strangler-fig) with clear sequencing, rollback paths, and coexistence with the current system during transition.
  • Establish a rigorous parity and data-reconciliation strategy so converted Python logic produces results equivalent to the original PL/SQL (record counts, field-level validation, transformation-rule verification).
  • Decide where logic should move from the database tier into the application tier, and define the data-access strategy against the existing Oracle backend.

Hands-on engineering & leadership

  • Build reference implementations / proofs-of-concept for the highest-risk conversion patterns; set the template the team follows.
  • Provide technical leadership, code review, and mentoring to Python and data engineers within the HIVE Fusion Team.
  • Drive engineering quality: automated testing (pytest), CI/CD, code quality gates, and regression coverage for converted modules.

Collaboration & governance

  • Partner with SFI HIVE / Digital Labs stakeholders to validate business logic and acceptance criteria.
  • Align designs with SFI's Architecture Review Board (ARB) and enterprise standards for security, integration, and platforms.
  • Where applicable, leverage Ascendion's AAVA platform and AI-assisted tooling to accelerate code understanding, conversion, and test generation.

Required skills & experience (must-have)

  • Python expert (3.10+): idiomatic, production-grade Python with strong design and OOP/functional fundamentals.
  • FastAPI: deep, hands-on experience designing and building REST APIs with FastAPI (Pydantic, dependency injection, ASGI servers such as Uvicorn/Gunicorn).
  • Asynchronous programming: strong command of asyncio, async/await, concurrency, and async I/O; designing asynchronous and long-running job execution.
  • PL/SQL & SQL (deep): expert ability to read, reverse-engineer, and translate large PL/SQL codebases — packages, procedures, functions, triggers, cursors — and tune SQL for performance.
  • Oracle database: solid working knowledge of Oracle (the current HIVE backend), data modeling, and query optimization.
  • AWS: hands-on experience designing, deploying, and running Python services on AWS — e.g., Lambda, ECS/EKS, API Gateway, RDS, S3, and IAM — including cost-aware, secure, and scalable cloud-native patterns.
  • Full-stack awareness: comfortable across the stack, including integration with a React front end and clean API contracts.
  • Application modernization / migration: proven track record converting or re-platforming legacy systems to modern Python services, with parity validation and zero-regression discipline.
  • Architecture: demonstrated experience as a solution/application architect — target-state design, NFRs, ADRs, and setting engineering standards.
  • Engineering practices: Git/GitHub, CI/CD, automated testing (pytest), containerization (Docker/Kubernetes).
  • Experience: typically 10+ years in software engineering with 4+ years in a senior architect capacity on data-intensive, business-critical systems.

Preferred / nice-to-have

  • Data access / ORM frameworks (e.g., SQLAlchemy), task queues / background workers (e.g., Celery, arq, RQ), and message/event-driven patterns.
  • Cloud & data platforms: Azure, GCP (incl. Gemini Enterprise); Databricks; Power BI / semantic layers.
  • AI / agentic engineering, GenAI-assisted code conversion, and exposure to AI acceleration platforms (e.g., AAVA).
  • Warehouse-management / supply-chain or food & CPG / manufacturing domain exposure.
  • Observability (logging, metrics, tracing) and API security best practices (authN/authZ, secrets management).

About the Role

We are looking for an ambitious, highly motivated and forward-thinking AI Integration, Automation & Innovation Lead to take ownership of the research, development, implementation and integration of Artificial Intelligence across our organisation.

This is not simply an IT support or ChatGPT-based role. We are looking for someone who is genuinely passionate about AI, automation and emerging technology and wants to become deeply involved in helping us build an AI-enabled organisation.

You will work closely with senior management, learn how different areas of the company operate, identify opportunities for improvement and develop practical AI and automation solutions that improve efficiency, education, administration, marketing, customer experience and overall business performance.


The role combines AI research, development, automation, integration, dashboard creation, data visualisation, experimentation, implementation, training and strategic thinking.


Key Responsibilities

You will be responsible for:

  • Researching new and emerging AI technologies, platforms and models.
  • Identifying opportunities to use AI and automation throughout the organisation.
  • Developing and implementing AI-powered workflows and business processes.
  • Automating repetitive and time-consuming administrative tasks.

jobDescription:
ROLE OVERVIEW

The Associate Client Engagement Manager works alongside the senior Client Engagement Manager to drive Celebal's commercial and client engagement activity across the GCC primarily Saudi Arabia and the UAE — with a clear path to owning accounts and transactions outright.

This is a hands-on, execution-focused role, but it is not a coordination role. You will be expected to hold your own in a first conversation with a Microsoft solution specialist or a client stakeholder without a technical colleague on the call, to explain what Celebal does differently in a specific solution area, and to build and defend a commercial estimate. Pre-sales, delivery and practice teams support you; they do not substitute for you.

Read this before applying: the interview includes a live technical and commercial assessment. Candidates who position themselves as functional or relationship-only sellers, and who require pre-sales support for every solution conversation, are not a fit for this role — regardless of years of experience or account pedigree.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Pipeline Ownership & Deal Progression

  • Own and progress a defined slice of the GCC opportunity pipeline — from qualification through proposal submission, negotiation support and closure — with the senior CEM as escalation point rather than as approver of every step.
  • Run RFP, RFI and tender responses end to end: interpret requirements, decompose the scope, own the response plan and timeline, drive contributions from pre-sales and practice leads, and assemble a submission that is compliant and commercially sound.
  • Manage Microsoft and partner co-sell motions directly — deal registration, co-sell submissions, MCI/ECIF and pre-sales funding nominations, and joint account planning with Microsoft SSPs, ATUs and partner leads (Crayon and others).
  • Maintain CRM hygiene, forecast accuracy and pipeline reporting to a standard that leadership can act on without rework.
  • Schedule and lead client meetings, demos and technical presentations; author the meeting narrative and the follow-up MOM, not just the logistics.

2. Client Engagement & Account Ownership

  • Act as a named point of contact for assigned accounts, holding day-to-day commercial and delivery-liaison conversations independently.
  • Produce client-facing material — proposals, BoQ and BoM summaries, executive briefings, project status narratives — in a form that goes to the client with light review, not heavy rewriting.
  • Track milestone status with delivery, trigger milestone-linked commercial actions, and own invoicing follow-up, collections escalation and revenue realisation for your accounts.
  • Maintain complete, auditable engagement documentation: MSAs, SOWs, Change Requests, LOIs, correspondence and approval trails.

3. Solution Positioning & Differentiation

  • Articulate what Celebal does differently in specific solution areas — Microsoft Fabric and Databricks-based data platform modernisation, migration accelerators, GenAI and agentic use cases, sovereign cloud and security — and why that beats an incumbent system integrator. This is a core competency of the role, not a marketing hand-off.
  • Maintain and actively use the GCC solution narrative: capability decks, reference architectures, case studies, industry-specific use-case libraries and competitive positioning.
  • Translate a client problem statement into an indicative solution shape and commercial envelope in the room, then validate it with pre-sales — rather than deferring the entire conversation.

4. Proposal, Estimation & Commercial Construction

  • Author the executive summary, scope of work, assumptions, exclusions and commercial sections of proposals; source tech stack, effort estimates and delivery timelines from pre-sales and delivery and integrate them coherently.
  • Build and adjust Azure consumption estimates independently using the Azure pricing calculator — storage, compute, capacity SKUs and licensing — and understand how those choices move the client's total cost.
  • Draft quotations, SOW summaries and Change Request documentation; understand the difference between T&M, fixed-price, managed-capacity and outcome-based structures and when each is appropriate.

5. Internal Coordination & Governance

  • Liaise with delivery, legal, finance and HR on engagement onboarding, commercial issue resolution and contract execution.
  • Prepare internal briefing notes, commercial summaries, deal review packs and escalation memos of a standard suitable for regional leadership review.
  • Contribute to WBS updates, revenue forecasting and weekly/monthly business reviews.
  • Ensure clean account handovers with full context and documentation captured.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

Essential — screened against, no exceptions

  • GCC market experience. 4–6 years in B2B technology sales, client engagement, pre-sales or account management, including demonstrable UAE and/or KSA market experience — in-market work history, or documented ownership of GCC-based client relationships. Regional exposure gained purely through remote channel coordination does not meet this requirement.
  • Microsoft partner ecosystem depth. Hands-on experience with co-sell motions, deal registration, and pre-sales or partner funding mechanisms (MCI, ECIF or equivalent), including working relationships with Microsoft field roles (SSP, ATU, partner development).
  • Data & AI portfolio literacy. Working knowledge of the Microsoft data and AI stack — Azure data services, Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Power BI, GenAI/Copilot patterns — sufficient to scope a data platform, migration or AI use-case conversation unaided.
  • Cloud and security fundamentals. Practical fluency in Azure architecture basics, M365/O365, and Microsoft security and compliance (Sentinel, Defender, identity). Certification at fundamentals level or above (AZ-900, MS-900, SC-900, DP-900 or higher) is expected; equivalent demonstrated knowledge is acceptable.
  • Estimation capability. Able to build and defend an Azure consumption estimate on the Azure pricing calculator without pre-sales assistance. This is tested live during interview.
  • RFP and tender ownership. Direct experience running or substantially owning RFP, RFI or government tender responses, including compliance and commercial sections.
  • Services-commercial exposure. Familiarity with MSAs, SOWs and Change Requests, and with authoring scope and commercial terms for services engagements — as distinct from licensing or product resale.
  • Deal scale. Experience on engagements where individual proof-of-concept values reach USD 150K or above and multi-year programmes exceed USD 1M. Celebal proof-of-concept engagements alone routinely run USD 200K–250K.
  • Applied AI fluency. Uses AI tooling deliberately in the sales craft — research, account intelligence, first-draft proposal and RFP response construction, competitive analysis — with judgement about what must still be authored and verified by a human.
  • Communication. Clear, professional written and spoken English; able to produce client-ready correspondence and documents with minimal supervision.
  • Education. Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, Computer Science or a related field. MBA or a technical postgraduate qualification is an advantage.
  • Mobility. Based in or willing to relocate to Dubai, with a valid ability to travel across KSA and the GCC.

Preferred

  • Arabic language capability.
  • Prior employment with a Microsoft partner, system integrator or technology consulting firm serving enterprise clients in the region.
  • Account experience in logistics, government or public sector, FMCG, or financial services in the GCC.
  • Exposure to sovereign cloud, data residency or regional compliance requirements (SDAIA, NDMO, UAE data protection).
  • Experience with CRM and revenue tooling — Dynamics 365, Salesforce, HubSpot, Clari.
  • Familiarity with government procurement portals and tender platforms in KSA or the UAE.

COMPETENCIES

  • Technical credibility. Can hold a solution conversation with an architect or Microsoft specialist and be taken seriously. This is the single most important competency in the role.
  • Commercial judgement. Understands deal structures, pricing models, margin implications and revenue recognition well enough to shape a deal, not just document it.
  • Independent ownership. Moves an opportunity forward without waiting to be told the next step; escalates with a recommendation attached.
  • Competitive framing. Can explain why Celebal, in a specific solution area, against a specific incumbent, in under two minutes.
  • Organisational rigour. Manages concurrent engagements with accurate documentation, clean CRM and reliable follow-through.
  • Stakeholder navigation. Comfortable across pre-sales, delivery, legal and finance internally, and across client procurement, IT and business stakeholders externally.
  • Cross-cultural effectiveness. Operates credibly in GCC business culture and with distributed India-based delivery teams.
  • Adaptability. Comfortable in a fast-moving, high-growth regional business with evolving priorities.

SELECTION PROCESS

Candidates should expect a structured assessment rather than a conversational interview. The process comprises an HR screening, a technical and commercial round with sales leadership, and a regional fit discussion.

What we assess


How

Solution positioning


You will be asked to pitch Celebal cold to a Microsoft SSP covering a named industry, and to answer why a client should move work to us from an incumbent SI. Generic value statements do not clear this stage.

Commercial sizing


You will be asked to open the Azure pricing calculator on screen and build or adjust a simple estimate — storage, compute, capacity SKU — without pre-sales support.

Solution depth


You will be asked to walk through the most technically complex engagement you have sold, including data sources, integration approach and platform choices, in your own words.

Commercial structure


You will be asked how a proposal is assembled — which sections you author, which you source from pre-sales and delivery, and how pricing model and timelines are arrived at.


CAREER PATH

This role is a structured route into a full Client Engagement Manager position. Candidates who demonstrate technical credibility, commercial judgement and independent account ownership will be considered for progression within 18–24 months. Progression is assessed on independent deal ownership and solution credibility, not tenure.


WHAT WE OFFER

  • Competitive compensation with performance-linked incentives.
  • Direct exposure to marquee enterprise and government accounts across the GCC.
  • Close collaboration with Microsoft field and product teams, including global initiative and sovereign cloud programmes.
  • Structured mentorship from experienced regional sales leadership.
  • Funded certification pathways across Azure, Data & AI, and Security.
  • Fast-track growth in a priority geography, within a global team spanning the Americas, EMEA, India, APJ, Australia and Japan.

jobDescription:
Digital Marketing Specialist Social Media & Performance Marketing

Location: Ranchi, Jharkhand
Job Type: Full-Time
Work Mode: On-site

We are looking for a Digital Marketing Specialist who understands that digital marketing is not just about posting content, boosting posts, or increasing followers.

We need someone who understands why people stop, watch, engage, enquire and eventually become customers.

Your job will be to combine Content + Consumer Psychology + Data + Paid Advertising to grow our social media presence and generate quality leads.

What You'll Be Responsible For

  • Build and execute our Instagram, Facebook and YouTube growth strategy
  • Plan content calendars with the creative team
  • Identify content topics based on audience interests, search behaviour and market trends
  • Work closely with videographers, editors and content creators
  • Analyse which Reels/videos are performing and why
  • Improve hooks, thumbnails, captions, CTAs and content positioning
  • Run and optimize Meta Ads & Google Ads
  • Create lead-generation and remarketing campaigns
  • Track leads from Ad Landing Page/WhatsApp Enquiry Conversion
  • Conduct A/B tests on creatives, audiences, hooks and offers
  • Build retargeting audiences
  • Monitor campaign performance and optimize budgets
  • Prepare simple weekly/monthly performance reports

The Skills We're Looking For

1. Social Media Strategy

You should understand:

  • Instagram Reels
  • Facebook
  • YouTube & YouTube Shorts
  • Organic content growth
  • Content distribution
  • Audience building
  • Engagement & retention
  • Social-media trends
  • Competitor research

You shouldn't simply tell us:

“This Reel got 50,000 views.”

You should be able to explain:

“Why did it get 50,000 views, where did viewers drop, what made people share it, and how can we repeat that success?”

2. Performance Marketing

Hands-on experience with:

  • Meta Ads Manager
  • Facebook & Instagram Ads
  • Google Ads
  • Lead-generation campaigns
  • Conversion campaigns
  • Remarketing
  • Lookalike/custom audiences
  • Campaign budgeting
  • Creative testing
  • A/B testing
  • Cost-per-lead optimization

You should understand metrics such as:

CPL • CTR • CPC • CPM • Conversion Rate • ROAS • CAC

But more importantly, you should understand what action to take when those numbers aren't performing.

3. Analytics

Working knowledge of:

  • Meta Business Suite
  • Meta Ads Manager
  • Google Analytics / GA4
  • Google Search Console
  • YouTube Analytics
  • Google Trends
  • Pixel & conversion tracking
  • UTM tracking

We want someone who can turn data into decisions, not simply download reports.

4. Consumer Psychology

This is extremely important for us.

You should be curious about:

Why does someone click?

Why does someone watch one Reel for 3 seconds and another for 40 seconds?

Why does someone save a video but not enquire?

Why does one advertisement generate cheap but poor-quality leads while another generates fewer but serious customers?

Understanding attention, curiosity, trust, objections, desire and buying behaviour will be a major advantage.

Content Marketing

You don't necessarily have to shoot or edit every video.

But you should be able to guide the creative team on:

Topic Hook Content Angle Thumbnail CTA Distribution Retargeting

You should be comfortable telling the team:

“Video achha hai, but opening ke first 3 seconds weak hain. Let's test another hook.”

That's the mindset we're looking for.

Qualification

Degree is preferred. Skills are mandatory.

Bachelor's degree / Diploma in:

  • Digital Marketing
  • Marketing
  • Mass Communication
  • Business/Management
  • Media
  • Advertising

is an advantage, but not compulsory.

Candidates with strong practical knowledge and proven results are encouraged to apply even without a specialized degree.

Experience

1–3 years preferred.

Freshers can also apply if they have exceptional practical knowledge and can demonstrate their work.

Agency experience, personal projects, freelancing or managing your own successful social-media pages will also be considered.

Who We're Looking For

Someone who is:

Analytical + Creative + Curious + Result-Oriented

Someone who doesn't wait for instructions for everything.

If a campaign isn't working, you should naturally want to know:

“Why?”

If a Reel suddenly performs 10X better than usual:

“Why?”

If competitors are growing faster:

“What are they doing differently?”

That curiosity matters to us.

What We DON'T Want

Someone whose entire strategy is:

“Sir, 500 ka boost kar dete hain.”

We are looking for someone who understands the difference between boosting a post and building an actual marketing system.

How to Apply

Please send:

  1. CV
  2. Previous social-media pages/accounts managed

  4. Any measurable results you've achieved
  5. Tools you're comfortable using
  6. Current location
  7. Current/Last salary
  8. Expected salary

We aren't looking for someone simply to manage our social media.

We want someone who can help us understand our audience better, build authority through content, generate qualified enquiries and continuously improve results through experimentation and data.Role & responsibilities

title: Sales Executive - AI Products & Technology Solutions
tagsAndSkills: Sales,Lead Generation,Cold Outreach,selling,Database Generation,Demo Scheduling,Pipeline Management,CRM
jobDescription:
The Role

This is a full-cycle sales role. You will own everything from finding the right prospect to handing over a signed client - there is no SDR passing you leads, no pre-sales team doing the first call, and no account manager taking over after closure. You do it all, with demo support available when you need it.

You will be selling across three distinct product lines to three different buyer personas - HR leaders, finance and audit heads, and operations or project managers. The ability to switch context, speak the language of different decision-makers, and manage multiple pipelines simultaneously is central to this role.

What You Will Do

1. Database Generation & Prospecting

  • Build and maintain a structured prospect database across all three product lines and their respective buyer personas
  • Source contacts using LinkedIn, industry directories, CODISSIA / Chamber of Commerce member lists, trade publications, and local business networks
  • Segment database by product fit, company size, industry, and geography (CBE, Tirupur, Erode, and pan-Tamil Nadu as the business grows)
  • Maintain clean, updated records in CRM - every contact, every interaction, every follow-up logged

2. Cold Outreach & Lead Generation

  • Execute outbound outreach via phone calls, WhatsApp, LinkedIn, and email - targeting the right person with the right product message
  • Craft personalised outreach for each product and each buyer persona - the pitch to an HR Manager is fundamentally different from the pitch to a CFO
  • Handle gatekeepers, navigate to decision-makers, and earn the right to a conversation without being pushy
  • Consistently generate 40-60 qualified conversations per month across all product lines

3. Demo Scheduling & Coordination

  • Qualify prospects thoroughly before scheduling a demo - understand their pain, confirm decision-making authority, and set expectations
  • Coordinate with the internal demo support team to schedule and prepare tailored product demonstrations
  • Attend every demo as the relationship owner - your role during the demo is to read the room, handle objections in real time, and guide the conversation toward next steps
  • Brief the demo support team on the prospect's specific context and priorities before each session

4. Follow-Up,

  • Own the post-demo follow-up process - proposals, pricing discussions, handling objections, and pushing toward a decision
  • Navigate multi-stakeholder decisions where HR, Finance, and Operations may all have a say
  • Manage sales cycles ranging from 2 weeks (SMB, HR product) to 3 months (enterprise, audit tool) simultaneously
  • Close deals, coordinate onboarding handover to the delivery team, and maintain the relationship through the initial implementation period

5. Pipeline Management & Reporting

  • Maintain a live, accurate pipeline in CRM across all three products at all times
  • Report weekly to the founder on: leads generated, demos scheduled, proposals sent, deals closed, and blockers
  • Identify patterns - which products are gaining traction, which industries are responding, which buyer personas are hardest to reach - and share insights with the team
  • Set and track personal monthly targets for outreach volume, demo count, and revenue closure.
